opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead research and draft hiring email
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, look up the profile and top repo, then compose an email to hiring@example.com with a lead summary (followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post) for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Note follower count and latest post; open the top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose and fill To with hiring@example.com
Fill Body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post>.'
